Here, the prosecution alleges commission of offences punishable under Section 13(1)(c) and (d)
r/w Section 13(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 as well as under Sections 409, 420, 468,
471, 477A, 201 and 120B of the Indian Penal Code, by the accused.

3. When these matters are taken up for consideration, it is submitted by the learned Public Prosecutor that, in all these matters, further investigation has been conducted and the supplementary final report is CRL.MC NOS.8487,8504, 8540, 8605 & 8608 OF 2024 7 S Ajith Kumar vs State Of Kerala on 4 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/4363276/
5 2025:KER:94015 ready to be filed before the Special Court on obtaining prosecution sanction, which is awaited.
4. When this fact is pointed out, the learned counsel for the petitioner in all these cases fairly submitted that in view of the filing of the supplementary final report as submitted by the learned Public Prosecutor, these petitions may be closed with liberty to the petitioner to file discharge petitions before the Special Court in all these cases, based on the original final report as well as the supplementary final report, in accordance with law.

sentences.text:
5. Since, apart from the final report under challenge in these Criminal Miscellaneous Cases,
supplementary final report is also to be filed, the learned Special Judge will have to take a decision on the basis of both reports to proceed further.

In such view of the matter, these Criminal Miscellaneous Cases stand disposed of, with liberty to the petitioner to file discharge petitions in all these matters, based on the final report and the supplementary final report to be filed, as the outcome of the further CRL.MC NOS.8487,8504,

opennyai_summary.facts:
Here, the prosecution alleges commission of offences punishable under Section 13(1)(c) and (d)
r/w Section 13(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 as well as under Sections 409, 420, 468,
471, 477A, 201 and 120B of the Indian Penal Code, by the accused.
opennyai_summary.decision:
In such view of the matter, these Criminal Miscellaneous Cases stand disposed of, with liberty to the petitioner to file discharge petitions in all these matters, based on the final report and the supplementary final report to be filed, as the outcome of the further CRL.MC NOS.8487,8504,
8540, 8605 & 8608 OF 2024 8 2025:KER:94015 investigation.
